content: The TCT 2013 schedule outlines the coordination of TV events for the conference. Open time slots are marked in red, and filming locations are to be determined. Below is the detailed schedule for each day: Tuesday, October 29, 2013 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Philippe Gabriel Steg Topic: The EUROMAX trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing ambulance initiation of bivalirudin versus heparin ± glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors in STEMI patients undergoing primary PCI. Embargo lift: Wednesday, October 30, 2013, at 9:30 AM. 2:00 PM 2:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Bent Raungaard Topic: SORT-OUT VI, a prospective, randomized all-comers trial comparing biodegradable polymer-coated biolimus-eluting stents versus biocompatible polymer-coated zotarolimus-eluting coronary stents. Embargo lift: Tuesday, October 29, 2013, at 11:37 AM. 2:30 PM: Open time slot. 3:00 PM 3:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Sunil Rao Topic: SAFE-PCI, a prospective, registry-based randomized trial comparing radial versus femoral vascular access in women undergoing diagnostic cardiac catheterization and PCI. Embargo lift: Tuesday, October 29, 2013, at 10:35 AM. 3:30 PM: Open time slot. 4:00 PM: Open time slot. 4:30 PM 5:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Sigmund Silber Topic: TCT wrap-up in German. 5:00 PM 5:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Juan Gaspar Topic: TCT wrap-up in Spanish. 5:30 PM 6:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Ajay Kirtane Topic: Daily TCT wrap-up. Wednesday, October 30, 2013 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Jean-Philippe Collet Topic: ARCTIC-INTERRUPTION, a prospective, randomized trial comparing two years versus one year of dual antiplatelet therapy after PCI. Embargo lift: Thursday, October 31, 2013, at 10:00 AM. 9:30 AM: Open time slot. 10:00 AM 10:30 AM: Interviewee: Dr. A. Verheugt Topic: TCT wrap-up in Dutch. 10:30 AM: Open time slot. 2:00 PM 2:30 PM: Interviewees: Dr. Sergio Leonardi and Dr. Ezio Bramucci Topic: TCT wrap-up in Italian. 2:30 PM: Open time slot. 3:00 PM 3:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Fausto Feres Topic: OPTIMIZE, a prospective, randomized trial comparing three months versus twelve months of dual antiplatelet therapy after PCI. Embargo lift: Thursday, October 31, 2013, at 9:30 AM. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Clemens von Birgelen Topic: DUTCH PEERS (TWENTE II), a prospective, randomized all-comers trial comparing zotarolimus-eluting stents versus everolimus-eluting coronary stents. Embargo lift: Thursday, October 31, 2013, at 10:20 AM. 4:00 PM: Open time slot. 4:30 PM: Open time slot. 5:00 PM 5:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Giora Weisz Topic: TCT wrap-up in Hebrew. 5:30 PM 6:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Ajay Kirtane Topic: Daily TCT wrap-up. Thursday, October 31, 2013 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Stefan James Topic: TCT wrap-up from a Scandinavian perspective. 9:30 AM: Open time slot. 10:00 AM: Open time slot. 10:30 AM: Open time slot. 1:40 PM 2:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Indulis Kumsars Topic: NORDIC-BALTIC BIFURCATION IV, a prospective, randomized trial comparing a two-stent strategy versus a provisional stent strategy in true coronary bifurcation lesions. Embargo lift: Wednesday, October 30, 2013, at 10:00 AM. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Jeffrey Popma Topic: COREVALVE EXTREME RISK, a prospective registry study of transcatheter aortic valve replacement with a self-expanding transcatheter heart valve in patients with severe aortic stenosis. Embargo lift: Tuesday, October 29, 2013, at 11:05 AM. 3:00 PM: Open time slot. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM: Interviewees: Dr. Rogerio Sarmento-Leite and Dr. Pedro Lemos Topic: TCT wrap-up in Portuguese. 4:00 PM: Open time slot. 4:30 PM: Open time slot. 5:00 PM 5:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Philippe Généreux Topic: TCT wrap-up in French. 5:30 PM 5:45 PM: Interviewees: Dr. Martin Leon and Dr. Jeffrey Popma Topic: TRYTON, a prospective, randomized trial comparing a dedicated sidebranch stent versus a provisional stent strategy in true coronary bifurcation lesions. Embargo lift: Wednesday, October 30, 2013, at 10:20 AM. 5:45 PM 6:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Ajay Kirtane Topic: Daily TCT wrap-up.
